title: Procurement and installation of Navtex Transmitting station, T Antenna at Vakalpudi Lighthouse under Visakhapatnam Directorate
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supplying T-antenna materials (copper cadmium wire, steel rope, shackles, clamps, insulators) for the NAVTEX transmitting station at Vakalapudi Lighthouse, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Vakalapudi Lighthouse Station, Tammavaram (Post), Kakinada, East Godavari (Dist), Andhra Pradesh, Pin-533005
sites.work: Supply and installation of NAVTEX transmitting station T antenna materials

scope.item: Vertical Element (three lines) and 3 Horizontal Elements of 7 leads 16 Gauge Copper Cadmium wire along with spacers
Winch Machine Steel Rope of 12 mm dia (Multiple)
D Shackles (Bulldog Clamps for wire rope & Copper wire)
Ceramic Insulators (Two Holes, 9 Rings, White, 10" Long)
GI "L" Angle Size: 25mm x 3mm with U type Hook SS

money.notes: Rates to include GST, transportation up to Vakalpudi Lighthouse, loading/unloading, labour and all other charges. 100% payment after supply of all items in good condition. GST and IT deductions as per rules. No EMD mentioned.

period.completion: Supply within 05 (five) days from issue of work order; no extension of time

eligibility: Bids to be submitted with copies of GST, firm registration, MSME, PAN, cancelled cheque/mandate form and acceptance of terms and conditions
specs: 7-lead 16 gauge copper cadmium antenna wire, 3 vertical lines and 3 horizontal elements with spacers
Ceramic insulators two-hole, 9 rings, white, 10 inch long; Teflon dome type insulator
GI L angle 25 mm x 3 mm with SS U-type hook
